species.name: Whale
mustRead: horizontal notched tail flukes
blowhole on top of the head
long paddle flippers and a smooth streamlined body
species.note: generic name - drawn as a representative baleen whale; flukes are horizontal, never vertical like a fish

species.name: Monkfish
mustRead: enormous flattened head far wider than the tapering body
huge upturned mouth ringed with inward-slanting teeth
fleshy lure on the snout and frilly skin flaps along the jaw

species.name: Coelacanth
mustRead: fleshy lobed fins on muscular stalks
three-lobed tail with a small central spike
steel-blue scales flecked with white

species.name: Ocean Sunfish
mustRead: body truncated behind, ending in a frilled rudder instead of a tail
towering dorsal and anal fins top and bottom
tiny round puckered beak mouth
species.note: Taller than it is long - it looks like a swimming head with fins; there is no tail fin at all.

species.name: Remora
mustRead: ridged oval sucker plate on top of the head
slim dark torpedo body
jutting lower jaw and low fins set far back
species.note: The sucker is on the top of the head, not the belly - it is a modified dorsal fin.

species.name: Archerfish
mustRead: flat straight sloping topline to an upturned mouth
bold black wedge bars on a silver body
dorsal fin set far back near the tail

species.name: Knifefish
mustRead: long ribbon fin rippling along the entire underside
no dorsal fin on the back
body tapering to a blade-thin pointed tail
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative gymnotiform/ghost knifefish. It swims forwards and backwards with the undulating belly fin, body held rigid.

species.name: Icefish
mustRead: translucent white bloodless body with visible internal structure
oversized head with wide pike-like jaws
large fan pectoral fins on scaleless skin

species.name: Mudminnow
mustRead: small cylindrical body with rounded paddle fins
dorsal fin set far back close to the tail
blunt rounded snout with an upturned mouth

species.name: Flying Gurnard
mustRead: enormous fan-like pectoral wings edged in electric blue
blunt armoured bony head
separate finger-like rays used to walk the seabed

species.name: Lancelet
mustRead: translucent blade-shaped body pointed at both ends
rows of V-shaped muscle chevrons visible through the skin
fringe of oral tentacles where a head would be
species.note: Has no head, no jaws and no eyes - just a stiffening notochord line running end to end.
